integrity: The universal strict inequality is analytic. The packaged numerical verifier only checks the closed-form matrix square and sample success improvements and is not used as proof of the continuum parameter claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the uniform-prior known-length returning-interval ensemble at i=2 and N=3. It proves strict SRM suboptimality but does not compute the exact Bayes optimum or claim strictness for all larger N.
title: The smallest returning-interval instance where the square-root measurement is strictly suboptimal
